D2-071.q: Ek model lambe paragraphs mein jawab deta rehta hai, lekin aap ko table chahiye. Prompt mein kya shamil karna chahiye?
opts: Output format ki wazeh tafseel, maslan 'Product aur Price columns wali table do'
Wahi sawal bare huroof mein likha hua
Kuch nahi; models table nahi bana sakte
D2-071.exp: Bilkul sahi output format batana prompt ki sab se asar daar techniques mein se hai: model structure ki wazeh hidayaat, jaise naam wale columns ki table, par chalta hai. Temperature sirf randomness badalta hai, bare huroof maloomat nahi barhate, aur language models maangne par tables, lists, JSON aur doosre formats bana sakte hain.

D2-072.q: Aap model se support ticket ko category mein classify karne ko kehte hain, sirf hidayaat de kar aur koi misaal diye baghair. Yeh kaunsi prompting technique hai?
D2-072.exp: Zero-shot prompting model ko sirf hidayaat ke saath kaam deta hai aur us par bharosa karta hai jo model pehle seekh chuka hai. Few-shot prompting prompt mein chand misaalein jorta hai, fine-tuning model ko bohat si misaalon par dobara train karti hai, aur retrieval augmented generation jawab ki bunyad ke liye nikala hua content jorta hai.

D2-073.q: Ek system message is se shuru hota hai: 'Tum tajurbakar travel agent ho jo amli aur kam budget wale mashware deta hai.' Is line ka asal asar kya hai?
opts: Model ko flights ki live qeematon tak rasai deta hai
Woh role, maharat aur lehja tay karta hai jo model apne jawabon mein istemal karta hai
D2-073.exp: System message mein model ko persona dena poori guftagu ke liye us ka role, maharat ka darja aur lehja tay karta hai. Is se quota ya model version nahi badalta, aur model live data se nahi jurta; real-time qeematon ke liye tool ya grounding data chahiye.

D2-074.q: Aap ki app users ke upload kiye hue documents ka text prompt mein jorti hai. Kuch documents mein 'ignore your previous instructions' jaisa chupa hua text ho sakta hai. Prompt ka kaunsa tareeqa sab se zyada madad karta hai?
opts: Document ka text system message mein izafi hidayaat ke taur par paste karein
Document ka text wazeh delimiters ke beech rakhein aur model ko batayein ke usay hidayaat nahi balke maloomat samjhe
D2-074.exp: Ghair bharosemand content ko delimiters se alag karna aur model ko batana ke yeh hidayaat nahi balke data hai, indirect prompt injection ka khatra kam karta hai; Prompt Shields jaisi services hifazat ki ek aur teh jorti hain. Documents ko system message mein rakhne se unhein zyada ikhtiyar milta hai, zyada temperature randomness barhata hai, aur system message hatane se aap ke apne usool khatam hote hain.

D2-075.q: Prompts ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Few-shot misaalon ka format wahi hona chahiye jo aap output mein chahte hain.
Lamba prompt hamesha chhote prompt se behtar jawab deta hai.
Mubham hidayaat model ko zyada azaadi deti hain aur aam taur par jawab zyada yaksan banati hain.
Aap model ko keh sakte hain ke jab di gayi maloomat mein jawab na ho to 'I don't know' kahe.
D2-075.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: model misaalon ka pattern apnata hai, is liye woh matlooba format mein honi chahiye. Doosre ka Nahi: ghair mutalliqa ya mubham izafi text model ko bhatka sakta hai aur zyada tokens kharch karta hai; asal cheez wazahat aur mutalliqa context hai. Teesre ka Nahi: wazeh aur khaas hidayaat andaze khatam karti hain, aur isi se jawab yaksan hote hain. Chauthe ka Haan: yeh hidayat ghare hue jawab kam karne ka aam tareeqa hai.

D2-076.q: Prompt ki har line ko us technique se milayein jo woh istemal karti hai. Har technique ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: 'Masle par qadam ba qadam socho, phir aakhri jawab do.'
'Jis format par chalna hai us ki do misaalein yeh hain: ...'
'Sirf durust JSON mein jawab do jis mein name aur email ki keys hon.'
D2-076.exp: Model se qadam ba qadam sochne ko kehna chain-of-thought ki hidayat hai. Namoona inputs aur outputs dena few-shot prompting hai. Assistant kaun hai yeh tay karna persona hai. Khaas keys wala JSON maangna output format batana hai. Quota deployment ki setting hai aur prompt mein likhne wali cheez nahi.

D2-077.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumlay mukammal karein.
D2-077.tpl: Poori guftagu par lagu hone wali hidayaat {0} message mein aati hain. End user ka sawal {1} message mein aata hai.
D2-077.exp: System message mein poori guftagu ki hidayaat hoti hain, jaise role, usool aur format. User message mein shakhs ka sawal hota hai. Assistant messages mein model ke pehle wale jawab hote hain, jinhein app history ke taur par wapas bhejti hai; hidayaat ya naye sawal wahan nahi aate.

D2-078.q: Prompt ki kaunsi DO tabdeeliyan model ko beech mein kaate baghair chhote jawab dene mein madad karti hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Temperature ko sab se zyada karna
Mazeed ghair mutalliqa pas-manzar ka text shamil karna
Lambai ki hadd batana, jaise 'zyada se zyada do jumlon mein jawab do'
Chhote jawab ki misaal shamil karna
D2-078.exp: Lambai ki wazeh hidayat aur chhoti misaal, dono model ko chhote aur mukammal jawab ki taraf le jate hain. Bohat zyada temperature jawab ko chhota nahi balke random banata hai, ghair mutalliqa text model ko bhatkata hai, aur sawal hatane se jawab dene ko kuch nahi rehta. Max tokens kam karna bhi output chhota karta, lekin jawab jumlay ke beech mein kat sakta hai.

D2-079.q: Ek lamba prompt bohat se paste kiye hue documents par khatam hota hai. Model kabhi kabhi 'Answer in Spanish' wali hidayat nazar andaz karta hai, jo sirf ek baar shuru ke qareeb aati hai. Sab se behtar hal kya hai?
opts: Hidayat system message mein wazeh likhein aur prompt ke aakhir mein dohrayein
Poora prompt bare huroof mein likhein
D2-079.exp: Lambe prompts mein models aakhir ke qareeb wale text ko zyada wazan de sakte hain, is liye ahem hidayaat ko content ke baad dohrana aur system message mein rakhna un par chalne ka imkan barhata hai. Zyada temperature randomness barhata hai, documents delete karne se zaroori context khatam hota hai, aur bare huroof hidayat ko wazeh nahi karte.

D2-080.q: Prompt ki hidayaat ke baare mein jumlay mukammal karein.
D2-080.tpl: Ghare hue jawab kam karne ke liye model ko kahein ke {0} jawab de. Aisa output lene ke liye jise code aasani se parhe, {1} maangein.
blanks: zyada se zyada takhleeqi andaz mein
D2-080.exp: Jawabon ko diye gaye sources tak mehdood karna model ko ground karta aur ghari hui tafseel kam karta hai, jab ke 'takhleeqi' ya 'yaad-dasht se' be-bunyad content ko dawat deta hai. Muqarrar keys wala JSON application ke liye parse karna aasan hai; nazm ya bohat lamba jawab code mein process karna mushkil hai.

D2-081.q: Microsoft Foundry mein ek solution ki model deployments, agents aur evaluations ko tarteeb dene ke liye aap kya banate hain?
D2-081.exp: Foundry project, jo Foundry resource ke andar hota hai, woh workspace hai jahan aap models deploy karte, agents banate, evaluations chalate aur woh endpoint lete hain jis se aap ka code jurta hai. Virtual network networking sambhalta hai, storage queue messages rakhti hai, aur Kubernetes cluster containers chalata hai; koi bhi Foundry ka kaam tarteeb nahi deta.

D2-082.q: Foundry chat playground mein prompts test karne ke baad aap ko aisa namoona code chahiye jo aap ki app se wahi deployment call kare. Kya istemal karna chahiye?
D2-082.exp: Playground ka View code option aap ke endpoint, deployment aur maujooda settings ke saath namoona code dikhata hai jise application mein copy kiya ja sakta hai. Azure Monitor metrics dikhata hai, Export template resources ki infrastructure definitions banata hai, aur cost analysis kharcha dikhata hai, is liye koi bhi model call karne ka code nahi deta.

D2-083.q: Do teams ek hi Foundry resource mein ek hi base model apni apni settings ke saath deploy karti hain. Application kaise chunti hai ke kaunsi ko call kare?
opts: Nahi chun sakti; ek model ki sirf ek deployment ki ijazat hai
D2-083.exp: Har deployment ka apna naam hota hai, aur applications wahi naam de kar chunti hain ke kaunsi deployment request sambhale, is liye ek model mukhtalif settings ya quotas ke saath kai baar deploy ho sakta hai. Model version khaas deployment ki pehchan nahi, region mushtarka hai, aur ek model ki kai deployments ki ijazat hai.

D2-084.q: Model deployments ke default content filters kaunsi harm categories check karte hain?
D2-084.exp: Content filtering system prompts aur completions ko hate, sexual, violence aur self-harm wali harm categories mein, har ek ke severity level ke saath, classify karta hai, aur configure ki hui hadd par ya us se upar ka content block karta hai. Spelling, kharcha aur media ki qismein harm categories nahi; izafi ikhtiyari checks mein prompt shields aur protected material detection shamil hain.

D2-085.q: Foundry portal mein model test karne ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Playground mein aap dekh sakte hain ke parameters ki mukhtalif values jawabon ko kaise badalti hain.
Content filters bana hua jawab check karte hain aur prompt chhor dete hain.
Playground mein system message badalne se model ke weights dobara train ho sakte hain.
D2-085.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: aap temperature jaisi settings badal kar asar foran dekh sakte hain. Doosre ka Nahi: filtering input prompt aur output dono par chalti hai. Teesre ka Nahi: system message har request ka hissa hai aur chalte waqt model ki rahnumai karta hai; woh model ke weights nahi badalta, jo sirf training ya fine-tuning badalti hai.

D2-086.q: Har kaam ko Microsoft Foundry ke us hisse se milayein jahan woh hota hai. Har hissa ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Test dataset par jawabon ko score dena
Tay karna ke kaunsa nuqsan deh content block ho
D2-086.exp: Models model catalog mein dhoonde aur compare kiye jate hain, prompts chat playground mein baghair code test hote hain, test data par quality evaluations se naapi jati hai, aur block hone wala content guardrails aur content filters se control hota hai. Billing kharcha dikhata hai aur in mein se kisi kaam ke liye nahi.

D2-087.q: Aap ki deployment ko zyada tokens per minute chahiye, lekin region mein us model ka aap ki subscription ka poora quota ek purani test deployment ko diya hua hai jis ki ab zaroorat nahi. Aap ko kya karna chahiye?
opts: Purani deployment ki allocation kam ya delete karein aur azaad quota us deployment ko dein jise zaroorat hai
Har request ke liye nayi subscription banayein
Model ki context window chhoti karein
D2-087.exp: Quota subscription, region aur model ke hisaab se milta hai, aur har deployment ko us ka hissa diya jata hai. Ghair istemal shuda deployment ko kam ya khatam karne se tokens per minute azaad hote hain jo doosri deployment ko diye ja sakte hain, ya aap quota barhane ki darkhwast kar sakte hain. Temperature aur context window quota nahi badalte, aur har request ke liye subscription banana maqool tareeqa nahi.

D2-088.q: Foundry model catalog se model deploy karte waqt aap kaunsi DO settings chunte hain? Har sahi jawab hal ka ek hissa hai.
D2-088.exp: Model deploy karte waqt aap deployment ko naam dete aur deployment type chunte hain, aur tokens-per-minute allocation aur content filter jaise options bhi set kar sakte hain. Training dataset aur layers ki tadad model provider tay karta hai, aur Foundry-managed deployments mein GPU drivers nahi sambhalne parte.

D2-089.q: Microsoft Foundry ke baare mein jumlay mukammal karein.
D2-089.tpl: Deploy kiye hue model ko test prompts {0} mein bheje ja sakte hain. Nuqsan deh prompts aur responses ke khilaf default hifazat {1} se aati hai.
D2-089.exp: Chat playground portal mein woh jagah hai jahan deployment par prompts azmaye jate hain. Content filters, jo Foundry guardrails ka hissa hain, deployments par default ke taur par lagte hain aur prompts aur completions mein nuqsan deh content check karte hain. Azure Advisor aur activity log prompts nahi bhejte, aur VNet peering aur autoscale rules networking aur scaling ke features hain.

D2-090.q: Aap Foundry mein RAG chat solution evaluate karte hain. Kaunsa evaluator check karta hai ke har jawab nikale hue context se sabit hota hai ya nahi?
D2-090.exp: Groundedness evaluator naapta hai ke jawab diye gaye context se kitni achi tarah sabit hota hai, jo ghare hue content ko pakarne mein madad karta hai. Fluency parakhta hai ke zaban kitni qudrati hai, jab ke latency aur token count karkardagi aur istemal ke paimane hain; koi bhi check nahi karta ke jawab sources se aaya ya nahi.

D2-091.q: DefaultAzureCredential class kaunsa Python package deta hai?
D2-091.exp: DefaultAzureCredential azure-identity package se aati hai, jo Azure SDKs ke liye Microsoft Entra ID credentials deta hai. azure-ai-projects Foundry project SDK hai jo un credentials ko istemal karta hai, openai OpenAI ki client library hai, aur azure-storage-blob Blob Storage ke saath kaam karta hai.

D2-092.q: Local development ke dauran kaunsa command aap ko sign in karta hai taake DefaultAzureCredential aap ki identity istemal kar sake?
D2-092.exp: az login chalane se aap Azure CLI mein sign in hote hain, aur DefaultAzureCredential phir us sign-in se aap ke code ke liye tokens le sakta hai. pip aur git mein Azure sign-in nahi, aur az deploy authentication ka command nahi.

D2-093.q: Woh Python code mukammal karein jo chat request bhejta hai aur jawab print karta hai.
D2-093.exp: Chat Completions API role aur content ke joron ki list wala messages parameter leti hai, aur choices ki list deti hai; pehli choice ke message.content mein jawab hota hai. input Responses API ka hissa hai, prompt purane completions andaz ka, aur output aur items chat completion response ki properties nahi.

D2-094.q: Responses API ke saath follow-up request, app ke poori history dobara bheje baghair, pichle turn se kaise jari reh sakti hai?
opts: Har turn ke liye nayi deployment banayein
Pichle response ki id ke saath previous_response_id dein
D2-094.exp: Responses API guftagu ki state service par rakh sakti hai: previous_response_id dene se nayi request pichle response se jur jati hai, is liye model context dekhta hai. Max tokens aur temperature output ki lambai aur randomness control karte hain, aur har turn par nayi deployment context kho deti aur wasail zaya karti.

D2-095.q: Python chat client ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: output_text chat.completions.create() ke nateeje ki property hai.
DefaultAzureCredential us API key ke saath kaam karta hai jo aap client ko dete hain.
model parameter mein aap ki deployment ka naam aata hai.
Chat Completions API ke saath guftagu ka context rakhne ke liye app ko pichle messages bhejne hote hain.
D2-095.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: output_text Responses API ke nateeje ki property hai; Chat Completions text choices[0].message.content mein deta hai. Doosre ka Nahi: DefaultAzureCredential Microsoft Entra ID tokens istemal karta hai, is liye API key nahi chahiye. Teesre ka Haan: requests deployment ko us ke naam se jati hain. Chauthe ka Haan: chat completions stateless hain, is liye history har baar bhejni hoti hai.

D2-096.q: Chat app ko model ke banate hue hi jawab lafz ba lafz dikhana chahiye. Kaunsa request option istemal karna chahiye?
D2-096.exp: stream=True set karne se service tokens bante hi response hisson mein bhejti hai, is liye app text foran dikha sakti hai. temperature randomness control karta hai, max_tokens=1 sirf ek token deta, aur n ek jawab stream karne ke bajaye kai mukhtalif jawab maangta hai.

D2-097.q: Aap ke chat client ko masroof auqaat mein kabhi kabhi HTTP 429 responses milte hain. Client ko unhein kaise sambhalna chahiye?
opts: Kamyab hone tak foran tez loop mein dobara koshish kare
Khali jawab dikhaye aur error nazar andaz kare
Intezar kare aur exponential backoff ke saath dobara koshish kare, retry-after value ka khayal rakhte hue
Request kisi random URL ko bheje
D2-097.exp: 429 ka matlab hai ke rate limit aa gayi, is liye sahi tareeqa yeh hai ke barhte hue waqfon ke saath intezar kar ke dobara koshish ki jaye, aur retry-after header mile to us par chala jaye; Azure aur OpenAI SDKs mein is ka retry logic hota hai. Tez loop mein dobara koshish throttling barhati hai, error nazar andaz karne se users ko khali jawab milte hain, aur random URLs fail hi honge.

D2-098.q: Code ke har hisse ko us ke kaam se milayein. Har tafseel ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
targets: Deploy kiye hue model ko input bhejta aur response deta hai
Endpoint ke zariye Foundry project se jurta hai
Project ke liye OpenAI-compatible client deta hai
Maujooda identity ke liye Microsoft Entra tokens leta hai
Files Blob Storage mein upload karta hai
D2-098.exp: AIProjectClient endpoint ke zariye Foundry project se jurta hai. DefaultAzureCredential sign in ki hui identity ya managed identity ke liye Entra ID tokens leta hai. get_openai_client() project se jura OpenAI-compatible client deta hai, aur responses.create() deploy kiye hue model ko input bhejta hai. In mein se koi files Blob Storage mein upload nahi karta.

D2-099.q: Python chat client mein model ko poori guftagu ki hidayaat dene ke kaunse DO durust tareeqay hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Chat completion request ki messages list ke shuru mein system message
D2-099.exp: Chat Completions API mein kul hidayaat system message mein aati hain. Responses API mein instructions parameter wahi kaam karta hai. API version, deployment ka region aur stop sequences technical rawaiya control karte hain aur model ki hidayaat nahi rakhte.

D2-100.q: Aap Chat Completions API wale kai turns ke chat client ka loop likh rahe hain. Ek turn ke qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: Tamam messages ke saath chat.completions.create() call karein
Jawab dikhayein aur agle input ka intezar karein
User ka input messages list mein shamil karein
Is message ke liye nayi deployment banayein
Assistant ka jawab messages list mein shamil karein
D2-100.exp: Har turn user ka input history mein jorta hai, poori list model ko bhejta hai, model ka jawab history mein jorta hai taake agle turn ko context mile, aur phir jawab dikha kar intezar karta hai. Deployment pehle se ek baar banti hai; har message par banana sust, mehnga aur be-maqsad hota.
